'''Tera-Su''' was<ref name="TOR" /> a [[Gender/Legends|female]]<ref name="Jedipedia-NPCData" /> [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as a [[Jedi instructor|Jedi combat instructor]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. A dark-skinned [[Miraluka/Legends|Miraluka]], Tera-Su lacked [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] like the rest of their [[Species/Legends|species]] and instead wore a [[Leather/Legends|leather]] band across the upper half of their face. While stationed at the [[Republic base camp]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]], Tera-Su wore white [[Armor/Legends|armor]] under brown [[Jedi apparel/Legends|robes]] and carried a single [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tera-Su first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] in [[2011]], as a trainer for the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] class on the planet Ilum.<ref name="TOR" />
